cvBridge: {confirmed} of {total} entries reviewed — reviewed work shows on your CV.
cvBridgeEmpty: No entries yet — work records you create here will feed your CV.

noContext.none: No active work context yet. When an organization invites you to its team and adds you, your work records opens here.
noContext.pending: You have a pending invitation. Open your dashboard to accept it — then the owner can add you to the organization.
noContext.pendingNamed: You have a pending invitation from {org}. Open your dashboard to accept it — then the owner can add you to the organization.
noContext.roster: You've accepted and you're on the team roster. The organization owner still needs to add you to the organization before you can log work here.
noContext.rosterNamed: You're on {org}'s team roster. The organization owner still needs to add you to the organization before you can log work here.

reviewNotEnabledNote: Review is not enabled yet. You can log your work now — but for entries to be reviewed, the organization owner needs to enable journal review for you.
whatDidYouDo: What did you work on today?
textPlaceholder: e.g. Studied 2 hours and finished a school project. Or knitted 3 pairs of socks and photographed them. Or worked 6 hours, handled 12 customer requests and prepared a report.
strengthensHint: Once you save it, this entry can strengthen this skill
skillNoMatch: No clearly related skills found — add skills manually.
reasonWeak: Weak signal — add if it fits.
newSkillIntro: These skills aren't in your profile yet. Your entry mentioned them — you can add one as a not-yet-reviewed skill.
similarSkillsIntro: No exact match — but your words look close to these. Nothing is linked: pick one only if it fits, and it's added as a not-yet-reviewed skill you can remove anytime.
addManuallyHint: If none of these match, add the skill yourself — the system won't guess for you.
newSkillError: Couldn't add it. Please try again later.
freeTextLead: Describe your work freely: quantities, time, location. The system suggests a structure — it becomes fact only once you select it.
example1: Worked 6 hours, helped customers, and handled 12 requests.
example2: Prepared a client proposal and aligned the project plan.
example3: Studied 2 hours, finished a school project, and presented it in class.
example4: Led a team, assigned tasks, and checked the result.
savedBody: Your saved details were added to your work history.
savedBodyWithDetails: Saved to your work history with {count} structured detail(s).
whoCanConfirm: Entries are visible only to you until you choose otherwise. Skills you link to entries feed your CV.
pilotBackboneNote: Your entries are private until you choose otherwise. The review layer is shown only when there is a real review.

projectContext.title: Project context
projectContext.body: Entries in this work journal will be linkable to a project once the project layer is enabled. The structure is ready, but linking is not active yet and nothing is filled automatically.

quantitySummaryHint: Optional quick summary — you can also write all quantities and units in the description above.
connectsLater: This entry can later connect to skills and records
engagementAmbiguous: This work could belong to more than one engagement. Choose which one before saving.
unconfirmedTimeBlocked: {count} logged duration(s) still await your review and would not be saved. Keep or remove them first.

timeline.title: What happened with this entry
timeline.waiting: Waiting for a human to review it — your organisation's manager or owner can review it; until then it stays the record you entered

entry.deleteConfirm: Remove this entry from your journal? It will no longer appear in your list. You can restore it right after removing.
entry.deleteBlocked: Entry already reviewed — send a correction request instead of deleting.

editEntryBanner: You're editing a saved entry. Suggest the structure again, mark what you're changing, then "Update entry" replaces the old version. To back out —
editPreservedTitle: Kept from the previous entry (you can change it):
editTextChangedHint: You changed the text. Press “Organize text” so the system re-evaluates the current text — the details below are still from the earlier text.

inbox.clarifyHint: Some parts are unclear — ask the worker to clarify the hours or works. The system does not guess.
inbox.clarifyHoursIntro: Hours unclear: the system found several time fragments and cannot tell which work they belong to.
inbox.clarifySuggestionPrefix: Please clarify how many hours you spent on each of these works:
inbox.clarifyGeneric: Please clarify which works you did and how much time you spent on each.
inbox.noSkillsRecognized: The system hasn't recognized any skills in this entry yet. You can approve the entry itself, or ask the worker to clarify the work.
inbox.writeConcreteWorks: Tip: write concrete words about what was done — e.g. taught a lesson, knitted socks, sold 5 items, volunteered 3 hours, painted walls.
inbox.confirmSkillsHint: Pick the declared skills this entry proves — they become verified.
inbox.projectNote: Entries can be linked to a project — the data model is ready, but no entry is linked yet and nothing is filled automatically. The projects / sites / client layer is filled in a separate slice.

reviewClarity.lead: Your review turns a worker's self-declared entry into confirmed evidence. Only a manager, owner, or client manager can do it — every confirmation is a real human decision.
reviewClarity.approveMeans: Confirm entry — it becomes confirmed evidence for the worker.
reviewClarity.confirmSkillsMeans: Confirm skills — also marks the picked declared skills as verified.
reviewClarity.requestChangesMeans: Request changes — sends it back; it stays self-declared until updated.
reviewClarity.rejectMeans: Reject — it stays the worker's own self-declared record, not confirmed.

inbox.emptyNext: Entries appear here when a worker you manage submits one for review.

result.approved: Entry confirmed — it's now confirmed evidence in the worker's journal.
result.changesRequested: Changes requested — the worker sees this in their journal and can update the entry.
result.notAuthorized: You are not allowed to review this entry.
result.rejected: Not confirmed — the entry stays the worker's own self-declared record in their journal.
result.reviewNotEnabled: Review is not enabled for this worker yet.
result.entrySuperseded: The entry was already replaced by a newer version — this card is no longer actionable and will be removed from the list.
result.entryDeleted: The entry was deleted — this card is no longer actionable and will be removed from the list.
result.staleTerminalHint: Nothing was recorded. If the worker saved a newer version, it appears in the inbox as a new card.

inbox.title: Entries to confirm

quick.title: Quick confirm
quick.subtitle: One glance, one tap: the card shows the worker, the date, the works and the exact skills your tap confirms. Every confirmation is your real decision, recorded only when you tap.
quick.entryOnlyNote: No unconfirmed skills — the tap confirms the entry itself.
quick.rejectedCard: Rejected — {name}. The entry stays self-declared in the worker's journal.
quick.batchSummaryLead: One confirmation covers every entry listed below and is recorded as your decision for each of them. Review the list before confirming.
quick.batchFailed: Could not confirm: {count} — open the detailed review.
quick.excludedNote: {count, plural, =0 {All exceptions reviewed — the whole list will be confirmed.} one {# entry with an exception will NOT be confirmed until you mark it reviewed.} other {# entries with exceptions will NOT be confirmed until you mark them reviewed.}}
quick.outcomeNotAcknowledged: not confirmed — the exception was left unreviewed

listEmpty: You don't have any work records yet — your entries will show up here.
listEmptyNext: Create your first entry below — it stays private until you submit it.
logViaChatBody: Work is logged in the conversation — say what you did and the record appears here.
navSubtitle: Show what you did — it strengthens your work card.
composerBenefit: This entry strengthens your work card.
noEngagement: You don't have an active work context yet. Join an organization or project to build your CV.
saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
notesRequiredCopy: Describe what you worked on — the free text is the records of record.
reviewMetaNote: Private entry · you review the suggestions. Manager / client review comes later.

fragment.unknownHint: The system recognised a duration but not the work itself. Add a short description — the label stays private until a human review step is added.
fragment.unknownClarifyPrompt: Enter a short label so this fragment can be reviewed. Without a clarification it will stay unexplained in the list.
fragment.unresolvedUnknownsBanner: {count} fragment(s) still need a clarification. You can save the entry without them, but adding a label helps anyone reviewing this entry later understand the context.

self_progress.awaitingHint: These skills have no reviewed journal entries yet. Add an entry that mentions the relevant work — suggestions will appear here, and your reviewed entries will build the records base.
self_progress.title: You have {n} skills

photo.label: Add a photo / turn into a photo report (optional)
photo.freeTierNote: You can attach 1 photo per entry for free. More photos and extended records will be a VIP feature.
photo.invalidFile: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
photo.limitReached: This entry already has a photo — the free tier allows 1 photo per entry.
photo.notReady: Photo storage is not provisioned in this environment yet — the entry was saved without the photo.
photo.prepared: Photo resized and ready to upload.
photo.tooLargeAfter: The photo is still too large. Try a different photo.
photo.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. The entry was saved — try attaching the photo again later.

modes.title: Entry type
modes.quickHint: Briefly describe what you worked on and save in one step.
modes.structuredHint: After describing the work you will first organize the text — time, quantities and direction become separate fields you check before saving.
modes.photoHint: A photo report is a work entry with photos. You fill it in here, in the Work journal. If the entry is linked to a project or object, the photos will appear in that project's work gallery.
modes.photoFirstNote: Start with the photo. A short description is still required — the photo uploads only after the entry is saved.

voice.pageIntro: Speak about your work day — you will review and edit the text before anything is saved.
voice.unavailable: Voice transcription is not configured yet. The transcription server has not been connected by the platform owner — recording is disabled until then. You can always write your entry as text.
voice.disclosureProcessing: Your audio is sent to a LabourMarket.ai-controlled processing server to be turned into text. No third-party speech service is used.
voice.disclosureWhy: It is used only to create the text below — nothing else.
voice.disclosureRetention: The recording is kept only until your text is ready (at most 30 days) and you can delete it at any time.
voice.disclosureNoAutoWrite: Nothing is added to your journal, profile or CV until you review the text and save each item yourself.
voice.disclosureAck: I understand and agree to voice processing
voice.limitsNote: Up to 10 minutes / 25 MB per recording.
voice.processing: Transcribing your recording — this can take a minute…
voice.reviewHint: This is what we heard. Correct anything before using it — the text becomes your journal entry only after you save it there yourself.

errors.bad_mime: This audio format is not supported.
errors.empty: No audio was captured — please try again.
errors.engine_failed: Transcription failed on the server — please try again.
errors.handoff_failed: Could not pass the text automatically — please copy it and paste it into the journal entry.
errors.internal: Something went wrong — please try again.
errors.no_worker_profile: A worker profile is required for the journal.
errors.timeout: Transcription took too long — please try again.
errors.too_large: The recording is too large (max 25 MB).
errors.too_long: The recording is too long (max 10 minutes).
errors.unavailable: The transcription server is not available right now.
errors.undecodable: The audio could not be read — please try again.

voice.permissionDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow microphone access in your browser settings and try again.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet mode — several entries at once
spreadsheet.hint: Each row becomes its own work journal entry. Empty rows are skipped; failed rows stay editable with the exact reason.
spreadsheet.rowUnexpectedError: Unexpected error — the row was not saved. Try again.

errors.quantity_invalid: Quantity must be a positive number.

templates.title: Profession templates
templates.hint: A template only prefills the text structure — edit everything freely.

aiSuggest.title: Suggestions from this entry
aiSuggest.disclaimer: These are only suggestions — nothing is saved until you accept it yourself.
aiSuggest.offNote: We didn't find anything new to suggest this time. The automatic skill recognition above still works as usual.
aiSuggest.needsMigration: This store is not activated yet — the suggestion cannot be saved for now.

proofLoop.strip: Entries → skills → CV → opportunities: {entries} entries this month · {evidenced} skills with records · {confirmed} reviewed

exampleLine: For example: I installed drywall partitions, read blueprints and worked with a laser level.
pipelineLine: Skills detected: {detected} · added to CV: {added} · strengthened by this entry: {strengthened} · to review: {review}
pipelineFailed: Entry saved, but skill recognition failed (code: {trace}). Use “Refresh recognition”.
unresolvedHint: The system did not recognise these fragments. Pick a skill from the catalogue, save it as a capability, or skip — nothing disappears without your decision.

compactEdit.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
compactEdit.conflictNote: This entry was already updated in another tab or session. If you want to keep the changes typed here, copy your text first — reloading the page will discard them and open the latest version for editing.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.noWorkerProfile: Worker profile not found. Open your account settings and enable the worker role.
errors.engagementRequired: Choose the work context (organization or project) this entry belongs to.
errors.notesRequired: Describe what you worked on — the free text is the core of the entry.
errors.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be a non-negative number.
errors.unitSlugUnknown: Not yet in the unit registry: {units}. Ask an administrator to apply migration 0017 (the productivity_units seed), then try again.
errors.missingOldEntryId: The identifier of the entry being edited is missing.
errors.oldEntryNotFound: The entry being edited was not found. Reload the page.
errors.entrySupersededElsewhere: This entry was already replaced elsewhere (in another tab or session). Reload the page and edit the latest version of the entry.
errors.skillSelectionInvalid: The selected skill is no longer in the skill catalog. Remove it from the list and try saving again — all other changes are still in the form.
errors.rpcUnavailable: The corrections function is not yet applied in this environment. Ask an administrator to apply the latest journal migration (0018 / 20260720100000).
errors.entryNotFoundMaybeDeleted: Entry not found (it may already have been removed).
errors.notOwner: You cannot modify an entry that belongs to someone else.
errors.alreadyConfirmed: This entry can no longer be removed — another party has already reviewed it. Send a correction request instead of deleting.
errors.cannotSupersedeDeleted: A removed entry cannot be edited.
errors.cannotRestoreSuperseded: This entry cannot be restored — a newer version has already replaced it.
errors.cannotRestoreCorrectionConflict: This entry cannot be restored — another live corrected version already exists for the same work.
errors.metricsInsertFailed: The entry was not saved completely: {reason}. The entry was discarded — please try again.
